feature: SharePoint vector freshness and fail-closed Graph synchronization

flows.name: SharePoint source-to-vector reconciliation
steps: Reconcile source IDs against non-null document chunk embeddings
Replay only missing vectors through the verified provider route
Fail the Graph cron when downstream vectorization reports any error
flows.expectedOutcome: Every eligible cataloged SharePoint document is searchable and any future vectorization gap makes the scheduled run fail loudly

claims.description: Every eligible cataloged SharePoint document has a non-null 3072-dimensional vector
A downstream vectorization error cannot be masked by successful source writes
The source RAG health monitor runs from the canonical repository on the intended schedule
